en.headline: Watchdog opens consultation on two radio licence renewals
en.dek: The Communications Authority is taking views until 6 December on Commercial Radio and Metro Broadcast, whose licences expire in August 2028.
body: The Communications Authority opened a two-month public consultation on Wednesday on applications to renew the sound broadcasting licences of Hong Kong Commercial Broadcasting Company Limited and Metro Broadcast Corporation Limited.

The authority said both licences run for 12 years, from 26 August 2016 to 25 August 2028. Both licensees have applied for renewal, as the licences require them to do at least 24 months before expiry. Because the licences end on the same day, the two applications will be handled together.

The authority said it would assess past performance, renewal plans, views from the industry and the public, and developments in the sector, then make a recommendation to the Chief Executive in Council by May 2027.
Written comments can be sent until 6 December. The authority also scheduled an online public consultation session for 7 November.

zh.headline: 通訊局就商台及新城牌照續期展開諮詢
zh.dek: 公眾諮詢由10月7日起至12月6日，兩台聲音廣播牌照於2028年8月25日屆滿。
body: 通訊事務管理局星期三公布，就香港商業廣播有限公司及新城廣播有限公司的聲音廣播牌照續期申請，展開為期兩個月的公眾諮詢。
通訊局表示，兩家持牌機構的牌照為期十二年，由2016年8月26日起至2028年8月25日屆滿。兩台已按牌照規定，在屆滿前不少於24個月提交續期申請。由於兩個牌照同日屆滿，通訊局會一併處理。
通訊局稱，會評估持牌機構過往表現、續牌計劃、業界和公眾意見，以及業界最新發展，並在2027年5月或之前，向行政長官會同行政會議提交建議。
市民可在12月6日或之前以書面提交意見。通訊局亦定於11月7日舉行網上公眾諮詢會。
